subtitles.zh: 为什么给化妆品公司取名ELF？它是Eyes、Lips、Face的缩写。
subtitles.en: Why name a cosmetics company ELF? It's an acronym for Eyes, Lips, and Face.

subtitles.zh: 直截了当，所见即所得。
subtitles.en: A straightforward statement. What you see is what you get.

subtitles.zh: ELF颠覆了美妆品类。我们真正要做的，是打造一家不一样的美妆公司，或者说一家不一样的公司。
subtitles.en: ELF has disrupted the beauty category. And really, what we've set out to do is build a different kind of beauty company, or really a different kind of company period.

subtitles.zh: 我们成立于2004年，在互联网上卖彩妆，只要1美元，难以置信。
subtitles.en: We were founded in 2004, selling color cosmetics over the internet for $1 if you can believe it.

subtitles.zh: 现在看看我们，22年后，我们走到了这里。
subtitles.en: And now look at us. 22 years later, here we are.

subtitles.zh: ELF现在势头正盛。净销售额连续30个季度增长，过去五年营收翻了两番。
subtitles.en: Where ELF is now is on a roll. Net sales have grown for 30 straight quarters with revenue quadrupling in the last five years.

subtitles.zh: 这家奇特的公司已成为重要参与者，与行业巨头正面竞争。
subtitles.en: The quirky startup has become a major player, going toe-to-toe with the biggest names in its industry.

subtitles.zh: 这是颠覆的宏大体现，而首席财务官在其中发挥了重要作用。
subtitles.en: That's disruption writ large. And the CFO has played a large role in it.

subtitles.zh: 曼迪绝对是个颠覆者。35岁时，她就已经是一家公司的首席财务官了。
subtitles.en: Mandy is absolutely a disruptor. By the age of 35, she was already a CFO of a company.

subtitles.zh: 38岁时，她成为上市公司首席财务官。整个职业生涯，她都是开拓者。
subtitles.en: And she became a public company CFO at 38. So she's been a trailblazer her entire career.

subtitles.zh: 我觉得她之所以能脱颖而出，是因为她做任何事都非常出色。
subtitles.en: And I think the way she just erupts is she's just really excellent at everything she does.

subtitles.zh: ELF在消费者中的成功，源于一种不羁的态度。
subtitles.en: ELF's success with consumers has been driven by an irreverent attitude.

subtitles.zh: 他们不会看到我的到来。
subtitles.en: They won't see me coming.

subtitles.zh: 以及对包容性的重视，将客户视为一个社群。
subtitles.en: And an emphasis on inclusiveness, trading its customers as a community.

subtitles.zh: ELF的高管团队遵循同样的原则。执行团队，即公司的高级管理人员，我们一起做企业决策。
subtitles.en: ELF's C Suite follows the same principle. The executive team, which are the senior officers of the company, we make enterprise decisions together.

subtitles.zh: 为什么给化妆品公司取名ELF？它是Eyes、Lips、Face的缩写。
subtitles.en: Why name a cosmetics company ELF? It's an acronym for Eyes, Lips, and Face.

subtitles.zh: 直截了当，所见即所得。
subtitles.en: A straightforward statement. What you see is what you get.

subtitles.zh: ELF颠覆了美妆品类。我们真正要做的，是打造一家不一样的美妆公司，或者说一家不一样的公司。
subtitles.en: ELF has disrupted the beauty category. And really, what we've set out to do is build a different kind of beauty company, or really a different kind of company period.

subtitles.zh: 我们成立于2004年，在互联网上卖彩妆，只要1美元，难以置信。
subtitles.en: We were founded in 2004, selling color cosmetics over the internet for $1 if you can believe it.

subtitles.zh: 现在看看我们，22年后，我们走到了这里。
subtitles.en: And now look at us. 22 years later, here we are.

subtitles.zh: ELF现在势头正盛。净销售额连续30个季度增长，过去五年营收翻了两番。
subtitles.en: Where ELF is now is on a roll. Net sales have grown for 30 straight quarters with revenue quadrupling in the last five years.

subtitles.zh: 这家奇特的公司已成为重要参与者，与行业巨头正面竞争。
subtitles.en: The quirky startup has become a major player, going toe-to-toe with the biggest names in its industry.

subtitles.zh: 这是颠覆的宏大体现，而首席财务官在其中发挥了重要作用。
subtitles.en: That's disruption writ large. And the CFO has played a large role in it.

subtitles.zh: 曼迪绝对是个颠覆者。35岁时，她就已经是一家公司的首席财务官了。
subtitles.en: Mandy is absolutely a disruptor. By the age of 35, she was already a CFO of a company.

subtitles.zh: 38岁时，她成为上市公司首席财务官。整个职业生涯，她都是开拓者。
subtitles.en: And she became a public company CFO at 38. So she's been a trailblazer her entire career.

subtitles.zh: 我觉得她之所以能脱颖而出，是因为她做任何事都非常出色。
subtitles.en: And I think the way she just erupts is she's just really excellent at everything she does.

subtitles.zh: ELF在消费者中的成功，源于一种不羁的态度。
subtitles.en: ELF's success with consumers has been driven by an irreverent attitude.

subtitles.zh: 他们不会看到我的到来。
subtitles.en: They won't see me coming.

subtitles.zh: 以及对包容性的重视，将客户视为一个社群。
subtitles.en: And an emphasis on inclusiveness, trading its customers as a community.

subtitles.zh: ELF的高管团队遵循同样的原则。执行团队，即公司的高级管理人员，我们一起做企业决策。
subtitles.en: ELF's C Suite follows the same principle. The executive team, which are the senior officers of the company, we make enterprise decisions together.
